note: The source-size budget of tests/unit/source-size-budget.test.mjs: a byte cap for every tracked file under src/js, and src/index.html, above 40 000 bytes. A file at or below 40 000 bytes has no entry, and its effective cap is 40 000 bytes; an entry for a missing file or a file of 40 000 bytes or less fails, so a split file loses its cap. A cap is at most its file's headroom ceiling: the size plus 10 %, rounded up to the next 1 000 bytes, so a shrink lowers the cap in the same change; a file's first cap is that ceiling. A cap only falls: the test compares every cap with its effective value in the most recent earlier commit that changed this file, and a higher cap, a file passing 40 000 bytes for the first time included, passes only when it is declared in the raises ledger of the pull request that needs it: an entry { file, cap, pr, reason } naming the file, the new cap, the pull request number and a reason of more than 30 characters. Raises entries are added, never edited. measured records the sizes (wc -c) at the commit the first caps were taken on; it is history and is not updated. The budget bounds how code is distributed between files, not its total, which the dist budget of scripts/build-config.mjs bounds.
